records.observed: Official Go docs list 31 named model entries, three plans, per-model windows: 5-hour 20%, weekly 50%, monthly 100% of the model monthly usage. Go Teams is priced per member and cannot be treated as the same individual plan.
records.note: Examples only, not a full catalog replacement. Official model identifiers, restrictions, and prices must be re-parsed and reviewed in the existing source-code adoption pipeline.

records.observed: Official Go docs show Gemini 4 Argon (no longer Contributor) 50% off input/output/cache-read token prices through Nov 30, 2026, with month-usage credits unchanged.
records.reason: Existing row uses prior identifier; date-bound promo now has a vendor-stated end date, so a time-scoped adopted point is technically possible, but requires reproducible code, outputs and current bench mapping.

records.observed: OpenAI help says Plus, Pro, Business allowance will be shared between ChatGPT and Codex starting December 2026. Instant chat will not draw from the allowance.
records.implication: Do not apply the future merged-pool rules to November measurements or invent absolute token allowances. Current Work/Codex allowance already follows a shared structure.

decision: Research-only change. Do not advance conventions.updatedAt or regenerate adopted.csv/derived/charts without modifying authoritative build_adopted.py and running the full BUILD.md pipeline. Date-stamped evidence is a staging input, not the new price snapshot.
